name: editExtraCurricularActivityType
description: Update an existing Extra Curricular Activity Type record by modifying its type name and/or category assignment. Only update the user-provided details; otherwise, remain unchanged.
taskName: Editing Extra Curricular Activity Type Details

basic.name: editExtraCurricularActivityType
basic.description: Update an existing Extra Curricular Activity Type record by modifying its type name and/or category assignment. Only update the user-provided details; otherwise, remain unchanged.

args.name: ecaTypeCode
args.description: The activity type code to identify the record to edit (e.g., "000001"). Either ecaTypeCode or ecaTypeName must be provided.

args.name: ecaTypeName
args.description: The activity type name to identify the record to edit (e.g., "Learning"). Either ecaTypeCode or ecaTypeName must be provided.

args.name: newTypeName
args.description: The new name for the activity type. If not provided, the type name will remain unchanged. Maximum 120 characters.

args.name: newCategoryCode
args.description: The code of the new category to assign (e.g., "000003" for "Arts / Creative"). The user must provide either newCategoryCode or newCategoryName.

args.name: newCategoryName
args.description: The name of the new category to assign (e.g., "Arts / Creative"). The user must provide either newCategoryCode or newCategoryName.
